description.value: Faubourg is a family-owned French boulangerie-pâtisserie founded in Vancouver in 2010, with three city locations including this Kerrisdale outpost. The bakery produces croissants, artisanal breads baked five times daily in a French deck oven, and a full range of pastries and macarons alongside a specialty coffee program. Touring cyclists will find a solid stop for quality food and espresso drinks in Vancouver's west side, with both dine-in and takeout available.
